title: Only partially embroidered
text: Only partially embroidered. I was disappointed to find that only a panel of the cover is embroidered, not the whole top. It's very difficult to see this in the picture, so it should be made clear in writing, or some pictures added. However, in spite of it being much plainer than I wanted, I will keep it because the cotton feels nice and it's exactly the right color.
